author: Abdinoor / 2D Labs
scope: Read-only primary-literature and experimental-feasibility audit; no laboratory work or external review.

sources.authors: Pauline Coolen-Schrijner; Erik A. van Doorn
sources.title: The deviation matrix of a continuous-time Markov chain
sources.publication: Probability in the Engineering and Informational Sciences 16, 351–366 (2002)
sources.reading_scope: Publisher metadata and abstract; author preprint sections 3–5, especially equation (3.11), and reference list.
sources.relevance: Verified established first-entrance renewal identity underlying occupation inequality; no priority claim for that identity.

sources.authors: Neill Lambert; Clive Emary; Yueh-Nan Chen; Franco Nori
sources.title: Distinguishing Quantum and Classical Transport through Nanostructures
sources.reading_scope: Full primary paper, especially equation (2), singleton return-probability derivation and classical Markov assumptions.
sources.relevance: Essential established two-time population comparator; dimension-independent Markov exclusion is not a new general idea.

sources.authors: Che-Ming Li; Neill Lambert; Yueh-Nan Chen; Guang-Yin Chen; Franco Nori
sources.title: Witnessing Quantum Coherence: from solid-state to biological systems
sources.reading_scope: Introduction, witnesses 1 and 2, formulas (1)–(6), experimental examples and references; primary author PDF also opened.
sources.relevance: Established population/propagator witnesses, restricted access and memory/preparation loopholes.

sources.authors: Zong-Quan Zhou; Susana F. Huelga; Chuan-Feng Li; Guang-Can Guo
sources.title: Experimental Detection of Quantum Coherent Evolution through the Violation of Leggett-Garg-Type Inequalities
sources.reading_scope: Introduction, inequality and assumptions, experimental apparatus and independent stationarity/memory tests.
sources.relevance: Existing experimental model-class testing and need for independent premise checks.

sources.authors: Susana F. Huelga; Trevor W. Marshall; Emilio Santos
sources.title: Proposed test for realist theories using Rydberg atoms coupled to a high-Q resonator
sources.reading_scope: Primary publisher metadata and citations in inspected later primary papers; full original proof not read.
sources.relevance: Earlier temporal-inequality lineage; no unread theorem attributed.

sources.authors: Jiming Zheng; Zhiyue Lu
sources.title: Mutual linearity in and out of stationarity for Markov jump processes: A trajectory-based approach
sources.reading_scope: Revisited abstract, introduction and trajectory-response kernels; section V comparison retained from preceding phase's explicit audit.
sources.relevance: Transient response and transition-probability-difference kernels pre-exist this program.

sources.authors: Qihao Guo; Botao Du; Ruichao Ma
sources.title: Entangling superconducting qubits via energy-selective local reservoirs
sources.reading_scope: Sections II and IV; experimental limitations; Appendices A–C and E. Data record identified but contents not downloaded or analyzed.
sources.relevance: Relevant programmable pump/loss hardware; does not establish our exact selective two-channel contract.

sources.authors: Guillermo Garcia-Perez; Matteo A. C. Rossi; Sabrina Maniscalco
sources.title: IBM Q Experience as a versatile experimental testbed for simulating open quantum systems
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and indexed primary article excerpts; author/university metadata cross-check. Full protocol not independently reconstructed.
sources.relevance: Experimental digital open-system simulation precedent, not validation of our witness.

sources.authors: Matthias M. Mueller; Stefano Gherardini; Filippo Caruso
sources.title: Stochastic quantum Zeno-based detection of noise correlations
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and indexed text describing repeated projections with randomized waiting intervals.
sources.relevance: Distinct repeated-monitoring protocol; avoid conflating random terminal readout with Zeno monitoring.

sources.authors: F. A. Grunbaum; L. Velazquez; J. Wilkening
sources.title: Occupation time for classical and quantum walks
sources.reading_scope: Introduction and definitions of monitored discrete quantum walks; not every result or subsequent publication inspected.
sources.relevance: Neighboring occupation-statistics literature; different measurement model.

sources.authors: Marios G. Pavlides; Jon A. Wellner
sources.title: Nonparametric estimation of multivariate scale mixtures of uniform densities
sources.reading_scope: Indexed primary text explicitly stating one-dimensional Khintchine mixture characterization; publication metadata cross-check.
sources.relevance: Established nonincreasing density mixture-of-uniforms representation.

sources.authors: David B. Colwell
sources.title: Hitting times, number of jumps, and occupation times for continuous-time finite state Markov chains
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and author publication metadata only; full article unavailable in audit.
sources.relevance: Further occupation/first-passage overlap check; no theorem-level conclusion.

sources.authors: Naoto Shiraishi; Ken Funo; Keiji Saito
sources.title: Speed Limit for Classical Stochastic Processes
sources.reading_scope: Main-text setup and equations (1)–(13), including the dynamical-activity definition and speed-limit theorem.
sources.relevance: Established motion/activity/dissipation tradeoff; mean dynamical activity differs from a uniform conditional crossing-hazard cap.

sources.authors: Yoshihiko Hasegawa; Tomohiro Nishiyama
sources.title: Thermodynamic Concentration Inequalities and Trade-Off Relations
sources.reading_scope: Version 5 main text, especially equations (7), (9), (13), (15), (19) and discussion; supplemental response derivation not fully reconstructed.
sources.relevance: Direct exponential no-jump and kinetic-concentration prior art; inspected text does not state the two-preparation occupation/reset-defect interpolation.

sources.authors: Juan Kuntz; Philipp Thomas; Guy-Bart Stan; Mauricio Barahona
sources.title: The Exit Time Finite State Projection Scheme: Bounding Exit Distributions and Occupation Measures of Continuous-Time Markov Chains
sources.publication: SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 41(2), A748–A769 (2019)
sources.reading_scope: Version 3 abstract, introduction, definitions and Theorem 1.1; implementation not executed.
sources.relevance: Established certified occupation/exit calculations for specified chains, distinct from an inverse model-class envelope.

sources.authors: Kristian Blom; Kevin Song; Etienne Vouga; Aljaž Godec; Dmitrii E. Makarov
sources.title: Milestoning estimators of dissipation in systems observed at a coarse resolution
sources.publication: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 121(17), e2318333121 (2024)
sources.reading_scope: Introduction, examples and discussion of coarse observation, memory and dissipation inference; primary published PDF also inspected.
sources.relevance: Established coarse-grained memory and thermodynamic-inference pitfalls; not a source for the proposed sharp reset envelope.

sources.authors: Gareth O. Roberts; Richard L. Tweedie
sources.title: Bounds on regeneration times and convergence rates for Markov chains
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and author-institution publication metadata only; original proof not read.
sources.relevance: Regeneration/minorization lineage; no theorem-level non-overlap conclusion.

sources.authors: Mats Gyllenberg; Dmitrii S. Silvestrov
sources.title: Nonlinearly perturbed regenerative processes and pseudo-stationary phenomena for stochastic systems
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and metadata only; full proofs unavailable in this audit.
sources.relevance: Perturbed regenerative/semi-Markov asymptotic theory is established; exact finite-horizon overlap unresolved.

sources.authors: Michael M. Wolf; David Perez-Garcia
sources.title: Assessing Quantum Dimensionality from Observable Dynamics
sources.reading_scope: Version 2 sections I, II, IV and V, including dimension and spectral methods and finite-data treatment. Preprint title is Assessing dimensions from evolution.
sources.relevance: Essential prior art for dynamical dimension certification and classical/quantum dimension separation.

sources.authors: Rodrigo Gallego; Nicolas Brunner; Christopher Hadley; Antonio Acin
sources.title: Device-Independent Tests of Classical and Quantum Dimensions
sources.reading_scope: Scenario, tight classical dimension witness and quantum-witness sections; especially the elementary N-preparation/N-message simulation.
sources.relevance: Distinguishes unrestricted prepare-and-measure dimension claims from our constrained dynamical realization problem.

sources.authors: Costantino Budroni; Gabriel Fagundes; Matthias Kleinmann
sources.title: Memory cost of temporal correlations
sources.reading_scope: Version 2 introduction and sections III and III.1, especially equations (4)–(13), autonomous memory assumptions and convex mixtures.
sources.relevance: Established finite-state temporal memory witnesses; external controller memory and shared model mixing must be explicit.

sources.authors: Lucas B. Vieira; Costantino Budroni
sources.title: Temporal correlations in the simplest measurement sequences
sources.reading_scope: Primary journal metadata and sections 2 and 3 of the full text, defining binary instruments and deterministic complexity; numerical searches not repeated.
sources.relevance: Existing temporal quantum/classical dimension comparisons for repeated instruments; distinct measurement contract.

sources.authors: Tomasz Bialecki; Tomasz Rybotycki; Josep Batle; Adam Bednorz
sources.title: Quantum dimension witness with a single repeated operation
sources.reading_scope: Witness construction, equations (1)–(6), and error-analysis setup; primary published PDF metadata checked. Reported hardware data not independently reanalyzed.
sources.relevance: Relevant implemented repeated-operation rank/determinant comparator, including continuous-time Markov models.
